thread:
sahil-partners: Heads-up — AcmeCloud marketplace listing went 5xx for some customers. Can we lock down a partner SEV path that covers marketplace + HW SI routing?

leo-eng: Agree. Propose: 1) shared channel #partners-sev-acme, 2) automated war room bridge, 3) explicit handoff timeline.

anna-ops: +1. For war room we should use the runbook and a single bridge link. I'll create the channel and add the oncall SRE and Acme contacts.

kate-ps: Adding Acme PS lead @acme-oncall and marketplace PM. Need clarity on who can approve pausing the listing. Suggesting a single point of contact on both sides.

oncall-sre: Oncall SRE here — when channel is created please ping with: `!sev start acme` so the bot sets priority and notifies the pager rotation.

marketplace-bot: Deploy monitor triggered: acme-marketplace / listing-service 503 spike > threshold. See: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/ACME-503

sahil-partners: Anna — can you create #partners-sev-acme and invite Acme contacts + `@oncall-sre` + `@leo-eng`? Also link the runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/partner-sev-playbook-v2

anna-ops: Created channel: #partners-sev-acme. Bridge link: https://meet.redwood/warroom/1778901234. I invited: acme-oncall, acme-ps, kate-ps, leo-eng, oncall-sre.

leo-eng: In the channel: short checklist for first 15 minutes: 1) Triage & scope impact, 2) Confirm rollback/fallback options, 3) Decide pause/disable listing, 4) Communicate to affected customers.

kate-ps: For customer comms — I'll draft a short note: "We're investigating an issue affecting Acme listings; working with Acme and Redwood engineering; updates every 30m." Will post after ops confirm.

oncall-sre: Running initial triage: logs show upstream 502 from Acme auth proxy. If Acme team can confirm no deploy on their side in last 30m we escalate to SEV-2 partner lane.

acme-oncall: we rolled a config change ~12:10 UTC. rolling back now, will update in 5m.

sahil-partners: Good — per our partner SEV ladder: 
- T0 (ack): shared channel + war room link + bot `!sev start`
- T1 (10–15m): determine owner & mitigation (Redwood / Partner / Marketplace)
- T2 (15–45m): coordinated rollback or disable listing; enable customer-facing comms
- T3 (45m+): exec alert and up-level contacts (Legal/CS Enterprise)

leo-eng: Also add a short escalation phone tree in the channel pinned message: names + mobile + timezone tags. Helpful for nights.

anna-ops: Pinned a checklist + escalation ladder in #partners-sev-acme. I also added a small snippet to auto-assign an incident number: `!incident create partner acme`

kate-ps: Posted customer note draft to pinned messages; will wait for engineering confirmation before sending.

marketplace-bot: Alert cleared: 503s dropped to baseline after Acme rollback.

acme-oncall: rollback fixed it. thanks for quick coordination.

sahil-partners: Nice. Action items captured: Anna — keep channel open for 1hr, then hand back to Acme PS. Leo — add phone-tree to runbook. Kate — send comms once we confirm no regressions in 30m. I'll update partner contract notes about on-call window.

anna-ops: Will close bridge in 60m and mark incident as partner-sev-acme-1778901234.

leo-eng: I'll follow-up with a short postmortem template in the channel tomorrow.

kate-ps: Thanks team :thumbsup:
